The payment is held because the requested payee billing@studi0-north.example is unverified, while the payee on file is ana@studionorth.example, and a payee-change request received on 2026-11-04 is still pending. A human must verify the requested payee and resolve the pending change request before this invoice can be paid.

This payment is held because Polyform 3D billed 40 hours against a 32-hour cap, and the delivery submitted on 5 November is not accepted. A human must check the hours billed against the contract cap and confirm whether the delivery should be accepted.
